reviewedBoundaries: Both required parent arguments are compared with fixed eeda and98 identities. Local HEAD remains the tested-context parent.
The exact rev-list parent sequence must be [98,eeda], rejecting a merge parent or other direct/indirect ancestor. An ancestry check is retained in addition.
Complete Git tree mode/kind/blob tuples may differ at exactly the two ordered generated metadata paths, with no product/test/published-evidence drift allowance.
The dedicated archive manifest digest is fixed. Its schema, source/previous commit, source tree, exact two ordered source paths, empty product delta and false new-execution flag are checked.

Each new archive destination must be canonical, without symlink ancestors, and a regular file with executable mode matching the Git mode. Mode/kind/blob, size/SHA-256 and exact Git bytes are mandatory.
All original six complete archive loops and their exact membership, source/destination and byte checks are byte-identical.
The published log/artifact loop retains all index/mode/blob/worktree checks, now anchored to98. The complete-tree comparison proves those paths did not drift fromeeda.

Original checkout, merge/unmerged-index, accepted b4aa ancestry, fixed lock/ordinary CI, tested-source membership/kind/mode/bytes/digest, exact runtime array and228 count, manifest preimage/schema/admission and whitespace checks are preserved.

Tested-cut digest remains an explicit required caller argument, then cut.head must equal eeda and acceptedBase must equal b4aa. The approved execution must supply final03 digest0c4ceab1; the helper does not hardcode that digest.
limits: Static review is not a successful custody execution.
The subsequent command must pass the exact reviewed final03 path/digest and a tested-public-manifest preimage that hashes to its unique cut row.
Publication lease/API success, current platform acceptance and general later-main compatibility are outside this check.
A different published parent or additional incoming path cannot pass this pinned extension; it requires separate review.
